snippet.title: RUNT | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
RUNT is coming to Steam on August 6th 2026!

RUNT is a rural gothic visual novel mystery where you follow the story of Runt, the youngest of five brothers, surviving a monstrous post-apocalypse in the town of Skipclaw, cloaked in bleak darkness since the sky turned black ten years ago.

Wishlist now! https://dreadxp.games/RuntDemo

Follow the Devs: https://bsky.app/profile/grimtaste.bsky.social

Join the official DreadXP Discord: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
